gaps: Chase reports a net loss rate only before Nov-2015.
universe: Figures are the trust's own, as its servicer reports them each month on SEC Form 10-D; trusts define them differently (Methodology §11 lists each trust's definition), so compare trends more than levels.

portfolio_yield: Chase's gross yield: “Yield – Finance Charge, Fees & Interchange” plus the yield on discount receivables, before net credit losses.
excess_spread: Chase's excess spread: “Excess Spread Percentage” of the CHASEseries.
